Rates.description:
Counts and rates for a pooled group of trips (ADR-026). Intervals are 95% bootstrap
intervals (ADR-027), null where the rate is suppressed or at 0 (or a share of 0 or 1).

get.description: Trips Metro's realtime feed marks canceled and hasn't shown as scheduled again, whose scheduled end is still ahead, as of `as_of`: the newest feed fetch the data covers, which can be up to about an hour old until M3. Filter with `line` (slug). Announced cancellations only: unplanned missed trips can't be known in advance.
